description:
The Revolution is the model that put us on the map! No expenses were spared to create this one of a kind, top of the line performance king! Exotic building materials such as 6061 aluminum, 7075 aluminum, carbon fiber are all beautifully manufactured and
machined to our exact specifications and then welded right here in California.

The highly regarded Schlumpf High Speed Drive that allows for a 75 or 85T equivalent front chainring and pedaling well beyond 50 mph with the click of your heel. The incredible amount of acceleration and speed meant sourcing the best possible brakes we can find; the Magura MT5 quad piston performance brakes, mated to the 203mm MDR-C rotors. This bike stops better than anything we have ever tested! To safely operate this performance bike, we have taken considerable time to dial in the suspension, needless to say, it is like floating on a cloud!

The Revolution offers up massive power with 5,000W as standard with an options up to 9000W. Speeds of 60+ mph are capable with the 7000W system.

This year we are introducing a completely new power system that is capable of up to 9000W with an all new motor system. This will not only increase maximum efficiency, but will lower the overall weight, and greatly increase the overall reliability thanks to numerous advancements in the control system. The new Revolution motor is far and away the highest performance motor we have ever offered!

*Off road mode must be enabled on private property, Bike will ship fully compliant with Class 2 laws (750W/20 mph)
